title: Amazingly Dense Chinese Baked Beans Scallion Pancake
description: A buttery, dense, and comforting Chinese dish featuring baked beans, made in a ttukbaegi earthenware cook, and is dairy-free friendly, formed into a scallion pancake.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and pepper.
Add the sliced scallions, baked beans, and vegetable oil to the bowl, stirring until just combined.
Gradually add the water to the bowl, stirring until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Brush the sesame oil onto each circle, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of each circle up over the filling to form a pancake shape, pressing gently to seal.
Place the pancakes in a ttukbaegi earthenware cook or a heavy skillet, and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
